mapper.select: SELECT * FROM watch_profile ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM watch_profile WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM watch_profile WHERE enabled = TRUE AND auto_trigger = TRUE ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watch_profile (name, watch_path, enabled, auto_trigger, steps_json, priority, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{watchPath}, #{enabled}, #{autoTrigger}, #{stepsJson}, #{priority}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE watch_profile SET name = #{name}, watch_path = #{watchPath}, enabled = #{enabled}, auto_trigger = #{autoTrigger}, steps_json = #{stepsJson}, priority = #{priority}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
